_comment: Who writes which file. scripts/layer_audit.py checks this against the
code (an AST walk over scripts/) and fails on any drift: an undeclared
writer, a stale declaration, a shared file or a layer crossing with no
reason, or a seed row whose `source` no writer owns. Ported from
Layers follow what a file is a record OF, except that anything derived,
regenerated every run and never hand-edited is `derived`, whichever
layer it summarizes. Patterns are matched in order; put specific paths

layers.raw: Fetched source copies and the fetch and parse state around them.
layers.review: Candidates awaiting a reviewer. Reviewers edit these by hand.
layers.seed: Records of record. Hand-reviewed or rebuilt from a named source; the build reads only these.
layers.derived: Regenerated outputs: the published data, its manifest and audits.

data/review/queue.csv.reason: parse.py appends new candidates; promote_reviewed.py only sets review_status on rows it promotes.

data/review/cases_candidates.csv.reason: build_sabin_seeds.py regenerates the candidate rows and carries reviewer columns forward (merge_candidates); promote_reviewed.py only sets review_status on rows it promotes.

data/seed/restrictions_seed.csv.reason: Each writer owns its rows by `source` and keeps every other row as it found it.

data/seed/contested_projects_seed.csv.reason: Each writer owns its rows by `source` and keeps every other row as it found it.

crossings.scripts/parse.py: Records what it parsed (raw) and queues what it found (review).
crossings.scripts/build_sabin_seeds.py: Rebuilds Sabin seed rows and holds back the rows that need a reviewer.
crossings.scripts/promote_reviewed.py: The gated step from review to seed; marks each promoted row.

scripts/promote_reviewed.py.reason: Writes the seed named by SEED_FOR for each promoted entity type.

scripts/source_archive.py.reason: os.path paths passed as run() defaults; writes via a .tmp then os.replace. Its selftest writes only to a temp dir.

exempt.scripts/precommit_gates.py: Rewrites staged files' line endings (csv-lf --fix) and temp files in its selftest; owns no data.
